integrity: Verified standalone finite tests supplement the complete proof; literature overlap checks do not certify global novelty.
scientific_limitations: All-n fixed-point homotopy conclusion uses integral Alexander duality, nerve lemma, simple connectivity and homology Whitehead; finite tests are corroboration only.
Only involutions exchanging graph bipartition classes are classified; no arbitrary-subgroup fixed-point classification.
No integral torsion classification for the quotient, nor genuine equivariant sphere equivalence.
title: Fixed-point spheres and full orientation character of balanced higher-matching complexes
